units.source_text: 这样一个我，当然不会像朋友们那样留心被烟花女破坏了重贞。

en.t: Being the sort of person I was, I naturally did not worry, as my friends did, about having my virginity ruined by a prostitute.

units.source_text: 这是因为烟花女并非为了爱客才接客。

en.t: That was because prostitutes did not take customers out of love for them.

units.source_text: 无论是老人、乞丐、独眼还是美男子，只要事先不知道，甚至连麻风病人她们也都接待。

en.t: Whether the man was old, a beggar, one-eyed, or handsome, if they did not know beforehand, they would even receive a leper.

units.source_text: 要是一般人，也许会安于这种平等性，买个最初的女人吧。

en.t: An ordinary person might have been content with that equality and bought his first woman.

units.source_text: 然而，对我来说，这种平等性是不符合我的性格的。

en.t: For me, however, that kind of equality did not suit my nature.

units.source_text: 四肢健全的男子同这样一个我，都以同样的资格受到欢迎，这是我所不能容忍的。

en.t: I could not endure the fact that a man with sound limbs and someone like me would be welcomed on the same terms.

units.source_text: 我认为，对我来说，这是可怕的冒渎。

en.t: I thought that, for me, this was a terrible profanation.

units.source_text: 假使忽视甚至无视我的X型腿这一条件，那么我的存在也就全然消失了。

en.t: If the condition of my knock-knees were slighted, or even ignored, then my existence would vanish altogether.

units.source_text: 就是说，我也被你如今所抱有的恐惧所俘虏了。

en.t: In other words, I too had been captured by the fear you now possess.

units.source_text: 为了全面承认我的条件，我当然需要数倍于普通人的更多的筹划。

en.t: In order to acknowledge my condition fully, I naturally needed far more contrivance than an ordinary person, several times more.

units.source_text: 我觉得人生也必须如此。

en.t: I felt that life, too, had to be that way.
